    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">开源自建，GPT 切换空间麻烦？一件帮你搞定</span>

            </h1>

<section style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px">
<blockquote style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: italic; padding: 1em 1em 1em 2em; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-radius: 6px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); background: rgba(247, 247, 247, 1); margin-bottom: 1em; border-bottom: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-top: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-right: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); margin-top: 0">
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 1em; display: block; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">字数 497，阅读大约需 3 分钟</p>
</blockquote>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">这几天给我忙的，最近写了一个Codex的TEAM 账号管理工具直接在本地运行<br>大概是下面这样肝了几天，能配合codex cli使用<br>有目前还有一些bug和不好用的地方，后面会逐步优化出来</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">项目连接，需要的佬友希望能贡献一个start<br><span style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1)">hongshungao/Codex-Manager: 一个Codex cli 账号管理与切换工具。为 Codex cli提供本地号池管理自动切换。<sup>[1]</sup></span></p>
<h2 id="0" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">ReadMe</h2>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">本地桌面端 + 服务进程的 Codex 账号池管理器，用于统一管理账号、用量与平台 Key，并提供本地网关与服务能力。</p>
<h2 id="1" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">项目简介</h2>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 桌面端（Tauri）负责账号管理、用量展示、授权登录与平台 Key 配置</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 服务端（Rust）提供本地 RPC + Gateway，支持用量刷新、账号轮询与鉴权转发</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 支持手动解析 OAuth 回调链接，避免端口冲突或回调失败</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="2" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">功能亮点</h2>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 账号池管理：分组/标签/排序/备注</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 用量展示：5 小时 + 7 日用量快照</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 授权登录：浏览器授权 + 手动回调解析</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 平台 Key：生成/禁用/删除</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 本地服务：自动启动、可自定义端口</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 网关能力：为本地 CLI/工具提供统一入口</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="3" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">技术栈</h2>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 前端：Vite + 原生 JS + 自定义 UI</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 桌面端：Tauri (Rust)</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">• 服务端：Rust（本地 HTTP/RPC + Gateway）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="4" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">目录结构</h2>
<pre class="language-plaintext highlighter-hljs" data-dark-theme="true"><code>.
├─&nbsp;apps/&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;前端与&nbsp;Tauri&nbsp;桌面端
│&nbsp;&nbsp;├─&nbsp;src/&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;前端源码
│&nbsp;&nbsp;├─&nbsp;src-tauri/&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;Tauri&nbsp;端源码
│&nbsp;&nbsp;└─&nbsp;dist/&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;前端构建产物
├─&nbsp;crates/&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;Rust&nbsp;核心与服务端
│&nbsp;&nbsp;├─&nbsp;gpttools-core
│&nbsp;&nbsp;└─&nbsp;gpttools-service
├─&nbsp;portable/&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;便携版输出目录
├─&nbsp;rebuild.ps1&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;打包脚本
└─&nbsp;README.md</code></pre>
<h2 id="5" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">快速开始</h2>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">1. 启动桌面端后，点击“启动服务”</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">2. 进入“账号管理”添加账号并完成授权</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">3. 需要时粘贴回调链接完成手动解析</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)">4. 刷新用量，检查状态与配额</li>
</ol>
